manifest.name: @hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism
manifest.description: Firecrawl-backed search provider (search + full-page markdown in one call) for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)

bundle.text:
# The dsh-web-search-prism bundle patch: registers the Firecrawl-backed
# search provider into the profile's web seam. Selection is the user's: either
# configure searchProvider: prism-search, or leave it as the only usable provider.
- insert:
    - id: web-search-prism
      name: '@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism'

readme.text:
Firecrawl-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam
(`ctx.web`). Backs dsh's `web_search` tool with **search + full-page markdown
in one call**, fixing the two gaps in the official DeepSeek-backed provider:

| Gap | Official (`dsh-web-search-deepseek`) | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| snippet | ❌ absent (only `cited_text`, usually empty) | ✅ `description` |
| content (answer) | ❌ never populated | ✅ full-page `markdown` |

The official provider runs each search as a full DeepSeek model turn (no dedicated
retrieval endpoint), so results carry only `url` + `title`. This plugin uses
Firecrawl's `/v2/search` with `scrapeOptions.formats: ["markdown"]`, returning
each hit's full-page markdown in the same call.

The plugin is an npm package that declares itself a dsh bundle via
`dsh.bundle.patch`. Install it with the plugin manager or pnpm, then add it to
your profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```bash
pnpm add @hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism

The provider is **keyless-first** — Firecrawl's hosted keyless sessions need no
credential. To lift rate limits, set a key:

```bash
export FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=fc-...
```

Or pass it via the plugin config in `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: web-search-prism
  name: '@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism'
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY

> **Without this step, your search still goes through the official DeepSeek
> provider** (whose `searchProvider: deepseek-official` is configured
> explicitly, so the "only usable provider" auto-selection never kicks in).

Set the provider explicitly in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: prism-search

Or set the env var (equivalent):

```bash
export DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=prism-search
```

```bash
node --experimental-strip-types --test test/index.test.ts   # tests (11)
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json                                    # build to lib/
```
